name: EPIC 220198130
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 6.9 solar radii and 0.97 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220198130 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 6.903286 (16th-84th percentiles 6.676259-7.155008), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220198130 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.967625 (16th-84th percentiles 0.892181-1.056105), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220198130: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4709.701 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220198130 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1131.679688 (16th-84th percentiles 1100.361328-1164.667969), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.04 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,132 parsecs away, 7 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.97 solar masses and 6.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,710 K at its surface.
